page.layout: One printed title page, one block, centred. Top: a large title in capitals. Middle: a smaller block of lines in mixed type. Below: a spaced line in capitals. Bottom: a small imprint line. A circular seal or stamp covers the lower centre; it is not printed text.

page.notes: The scan is low in contrast and the middle lines show mirrored show-through from the reverse, so most lines below the title are unreadable with confidence. Only the first four lines and "IOANNIS HENRICI HOTTINGERI" are fairly clear; the rest are marked illegible or uncertain. The line "VVMERIS ... ILLENST" is a best guess from the spaced capitals and is marked [?]. The imprint at the very foot is too faint to read. A circular seal or library stamp sits in the lower centre and a brown stain covers the left side; neither is transcribed. The bottom-right edge shows part of the neighbouring page and is excluded.
